read.en: Lumentum fell 8.6% on Oct 30 to $840.70, trading between $805.29 and $887.60 on 1.5 times average volume. It is above the falling 10-day ($837.5) and rising 200-day ($801.2), and below the rising 5-day ($871.7) and falling 30-day ($938.1) and 100-day ($868.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram near a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($749.26), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月30日下跌 8.6%，收于 $840.70，盘中区间 $805.29–887.60，成交量为均量的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 10 日（$837.5）和上行的 200 日均线（$801.2）上方，低于上行的 5 日（$871.7）以及下行的 30 日（$938.1）和 100 日均线（$868.5）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$749.26），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The Oct 29 spike to $978.4 faded; Oct 30 lost the $893–897 and $868–873 (100-day) supports, now resistance. Resistance is $868.5–871.7 (100 and 5-day), then $887.6–897 (October and Jul 23 highs) and $938 (30-day). Support is $832–837.5 (Sep 15 low, 10-day), then $801–809 (200-day, Oct 30 low) and $736–756 (Oct 23 low, SAR). A close above $872 would target $893–897; below $832, $801–809.
